description: Plan card-show trips, discover shows and shops, browse Online stores and breakers, and organize your private show plans.

defaultPrompt: Which shows near Nashville this month fit my collecting interests?
Find reviewed Online stores and breakers for Pokémon singles.
Build me a show-day brief for the exact CardShow event I saved.
interface.longDescription: Find card shows and shops, browse reviewed Online stores and breakers, and prepare your next collecting trip. Use your saved shows, followed activity, private plans, and optional connected HobbyWise Hunt List. Search and filter business profiles and review selling links. Private shortlist changes require confirmation. Business listings are submitted and managed in CardShow through its review process. Selling links and seller declarations are leads, not stock, authenticity, or availability guarantees.

review.commerce_description: No transactions or purchases are processed by this plugin. CardShow sells an optional Pro subscription in its native app for business listing and private shortlists. Online directory browsing is free.

publication.release_notes: CardShow 1.1.0 adds Free Online browsing/search/filtering and Pro private shortlists. Businesses need Pro and app review to list. Preserves existing tools and endpoint. Activity briefing now tolerates unavailable saved shows without deleting saved records.
